messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: oncall -> high error rate + latency spike on inference-us-west pool. Incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0912

Maria Gonzalez: Observed a rapid KV cache eviction cascade after a batching rollout and partial quant rollout. Customer-facing errors started ~03:22 PT, peak ~03:28 PT. Estimating ~110k requests impacted, peak errors ~5.2%. No data exposure. Starting live mitigation.

Ajay Singh: Oncall taking pager. First steps: 1) pause batching rollout, 2) reduce batch max size for hot models, 3) pin quant profiles to last-known-good. Who can flip the quant pin?

Kevin Cho: I can pin quant profiles now for the affected families. Running ops command in 2m and then a fast perf smoke. MR: gitlab.com/redwood/inference/merge_requests/4299 (pin + smoke). Suggest temporary batch-cap 64 for family-z.

Maria Gonzalez: Adding a quick log snippet for timeline to paste into postmortem timeline:
```
2026-09-12T03:18:12Z canary-batch-rollout start
2026-09-12T03:20:05Z kv.cache.eviction.rate 0.02 -> 0.48 (miss wave)
2026-09-12T03:27:10Z p95/p99 increase, 5xx spike
2026-09-12T03:34:40Z rollback batching-canary + quant pin applied
```

Ajay Singh: Exec commands I'm running now:
```
opsctl deploy pause rollout batching/heuristic/v2 --reason INC-2026-0912
opsctl model set-profile --model family-z --profile 4.1.0 --force --reason "inc pin"
opsctl config set batching.max_batch_size family-z 64
```
Will post links to ops logs.

SRE Lead: Live routing change: enabling route-level circuit-breaker (latency-based) for 15m to reduce tail amplification. Also enabling additional kv.eviction alert with lower threshold for early detection.

OpsBot: opsctl: rollback job queued (job id: 908172). Expected apply ~30s.

Kevin Cho: Pin applied, running perf smoke: ci/perf/quick-quant -> will update. If smoke fails, we'll revert pin and open hotfix.

Maria Gonzalez: Customer impact note: three paying customers saw degraded responses (support ticket numbers: #4231, #4234, #4237). Eng-sre to coordinate customer comms with support.

Lia Park: I'll schedule the postmortem. Prefer a 45m slot with async pre-read. Tue 09:00 PT or Wed 14:00 PT — which works? I'll create the doc here: https://docs.redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-0912. Add any pre-reads as comments. :calendar:

Ajay Singh: Handoff: I'm staying on for 20m to watch stabilization, then Kevin will own verification and blameless timeline drafting. @Kevin confirm you'll take the 2nd shift.

Kevin Cho: Confirmed. Perf smoke passed (p99 ~1.02x baseline). Holding quant pin for now while we run extended perf jobs. Will add results to MR 4299.

SRE Lead: Action checklist (owner 2026-09-1226 due):
- [ ] Pause batching rollout and confirm stable (Ajay 1796-09-12T04:00Z26)
- [ ] Pin quant profiles + perf gating (Kevin 1796-09-12T04:30Z26)
- [ ] Add kv.eviction early-warning alert + dashboards (Maria/SRE 1796-09-1426)
- [ ] Short RFC for prefix warmup and admission control (Maria 1796-09-1626)
- [ ] Postmortem draft + blameless timeline (Lia 1796-09-1326)
- [ ] Create remediation epic and link tasks (SRE Lead 1796-09-1526)

Maria Gonzalez: Drafting prefix-warmup + admission control doc now and will attach to the incident page. Will include metrics to monitor: kv.hit_ratio, kv.eviction_rate, batching.queue_len, quant.load_failure_rate.

Ajay Singh: Rollback confirmed applied, latency dropping towards baseline. I'll update the incident page with time-to-recover.

incident-bot: REMINDER: update INC-2026-0912 with final remediation statuses. This thread will be used for live mitigation updates and follow-ups until the postmortem completes. :white_check_mark:
